$comment: Per-file budgets for unbundled public assets. Baseline 2026-09-30 (raw/gzip bytes): events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Ceilings leave roughly 25-45% headroom, not room for a framework import. The rebased copy-link island is initially budgeted at raw/gzip 2441/1009 bytes (ceilings 3072/1280). Stylesheet declarations are whitespace-compacted (identical parsed CSS). The stylesheet ceilings remain 3072/1280 raw/gzip; growth on main must be optimized without removing styles or raising these ceilings here. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires a separate deliberate PR explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green.
